title: The Beginning
description:
They say Hampi is a place where time stands still, but for me, that’s where everything started moving. We were walking through those old streets, surrounded by people selling ancient coins and relics from a forgotten empire. I was looking at the history in the stalls, but then I looked at you and realized I was looking at my future. Amongst all those 'precious' ancient items, you were the only thing I didn't want to lose. It wasn't the gold or the old coins that caught my eye; it was the way you looked against the backdrop of those stone ruins. That was the moment I fell, right there in the dust and the history of Hampi.
Found a treasure in the streets of Vijayanagara that wasn't for sale.
